statement.zh: Chu 2006：班杜里亚存在先前未充分报道的纪念性区（约 20 ha；主丘 8–12 m），1 号丘为卵石泥浆截顶金字塔并伴圆形沉陷广场。
statement.en: Chu 2006: Bandurria has a previously under-reported monumental sector (~20 ha; main mounds 8–12 m); Mound 1 is a cobble-and-mud truncated pyramid with a circular sunken plaza.
